sn46.48:1.1: “Bhikkhus, this is the forerunner and precursor of the rising of the sun, that is, the dawn.
sn46.48:1.2: So too, for a bhikkhu this is the forerunner and precursor of the arising of the seven factors of enlightenment, that is, good friendship.
sn46.48:1.3: When a bhikkhu has a good friend, it is to be expected that he will develop and cultivate the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.48:1.4: “And how does a bhikkhu who has a good friend develop and cultivate the seven factors of enlightenment?
sn46.48:1.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness … he develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity,
sn46.48:1.6: which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release.
sn46.48:1.7: It is in this way that a bhikkhu who has a good friend develops and cultivates the seven factors of enlightenment.”
